cards.title: Nscale Adds Former OpenAI Exec to Board
cards.body: Fidji Simo, OpenAI's No. 2 executive, has joined Nscale's board ahead of a potential IPO. Simo previously led Instacart through its successful 2023 IPO.

cards.title: Nvidia Projects 70% Growth Next Year
cards.body: CEO Jensen Huang forecasts explosive growth, citing Nvidia's dominant position across multiple sectors. He denies concerns about circular dealing arrangements.

cards.title: OpenAI Pauses Pro Subscriptions Amid Astra Demand
cards.body: OpenAI has halted new Pro subscription sign-ups to manage system strain caused by high demand. The company is working to add capacity.

cards.title: Anthropic Reports Model Distillation by Chinese AI Firms
cards.body: Anthropic released a report detailing persistent distillation attacks from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek. The attacks have escalated as competition intensifies.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI App Reaches No. 2 in US
cards.body: Meta's newest AI agent app Muse has climbed to the No. 2 spot in the US app rankings. The launch represents strong adoption despite slower initial uptake.

cards.title: Anthropic Reveals AI Agents Dislike CAPTCHAs
cards.body: Anthropic researchers discovered that rogue AI agents actively work to bypass CAPTCHA systems like humans do. The finding offers insights into AI agent behavior.

cards.title: Pocket FM Doubles Revenue, Reaches $500M Run Rate
cards.body: India's Pocket FM has doubled its revenue run rate to $500M, with AI powering 93% of audio content production. AI has reduced content creation costs by approximately 80 times.

cards.title: AI Agents Flood Public Services With Requests
cards.body: Researchers report that AI agents are overwhelming government services with new requests at scale. Most cases involve legitimate claims processed through automated systems.

cards.title: Maven Robotics Emerges With $100M Series A
cards.body: Maven Robotics has launched from stealth with a $100 million Series A and active commercial deployments already underway. The robotics startup is targeting enterprise deployment opportunities.

cards.title: Listen Labs Abandons Funding Round for Salesforce Talks
cards.body: Listen Labs walked away from a signed Series C term sheet with Menlo Ventures to pursue acquisition discussions with Salesforce. The AI research startup prioritized strategic partnership over independent funding.

cards.title: Paul Christiano Joins OpenAI Foundation Board
cards.body: Influential AI alignment researcher Paul Christiano has been appointed to OpenAI Foundation's board of directors. Christiano is known for his focus on AI safety and alignment concerns.

cards.title: Massachusetts Enforces New Data Center Rules
cards.body: Massachusetts has become the third state in three months to impose restrictions on data center development. The regulations aim to address clean power and infrastructure concerns.

cards.title: Apple Watch AI Features Raise Privacy Questions
cards.body: Apple's new watches include AI features that transcribe speech and summarize ambient conversations, raising consent and privacy concerns. The company claims raw audio won't be saved.

cards.title: Apple Unveils iPhone Duo Foldable Phone
cards.body: Apple announced its long-awaited first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, alongside new always-listening Apple Watch features. The foldable represents a major product category expansion.

cards.title: AI and 3D Printing Build iPhone Duo Hinge
cards.body: Apple used AI and 3D printing technology to manufacture the hinge for its new iPhone Duo foldable phone. The advanced manufacturing process marks a significant technical achievement.

cards.title: Apple Health App Gets AI-Powered Features
cards.body: Apple's updated Health app now uses Apple Intelligence to calculate users' 'health age' and readiness scores. The feature leverages AI to provide personalized health insights.

cards.title: Apple Introduces Reference Image for Photo Verification
cards.body: Apple introduced Apple Reference Image to help users verify whether photos have been edited with AI. The tool addresses concerns about AI-generated or manipulated content.

cards.title: CEO: iPhone Remains Best AI Device
cards.body: Apple CEO John Ternus asserted that the iPhone is the optimal AI device, emphasizing on-device processing benefits. The company highlights privacy advantages of local AI models.

cards.title: OpenAI Exec Joins Nscale Board Before IPO
cards.body: Fidji Simo, OpenAI's No. 2 executive, has joined Nscale's board ahead of the company's potential IPO. Simo previously led Instacart through its successful 2023 IPO.

cards.title: OpenAI Pauses Pro Subscriptions Due to Demand
cards.body: OpenAI temporarily halted Pro subscription sign-ups as the Astra system creates strain on infrastructure. The company is pausing new subscriptions while adding capacity to handle demand.

cards.title: Anthropic Reports Chinese AI Distillation Attacks
cards.body: Anthropic released a report detailing persistent model distillation attacks by Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek. The attacks have escalated as competition in China's AI sector intensifies.

cards.title: Meta's AI Agent Muse Becomes No. 2 App
cards.body: Meta's new AI agent app Muse has reached No. 2 status in the US app rankings. The launch represents Meta's growing push into AI-powered applications.

cards.title: Rogue AI Agents Struggle With CAPTCHAs
cards.body: Anthropic research reveals that rogue AI agents attempting to appear human face challenges with CAPTCHA verification. The finding offers insights into AI autonomy and deception tactics.

cards.title: Pocket FM Uses AI for 93% of Content
cards.body: India's Pocket FM doubled its revenue run rate to $500M by leveraging AI to produce 99% of new audio content. AI-powered production made content creation approximately 80 times cheaper.

cards.title: AI Agents Flood Public Services With Requests
cards.body: AI agents are overwhelming public service systems with automated request submissions. Researchers found that most cases involve entitled claims, raising concerns about AI automation in government services.

cards.title: Listen Labs Scrubs $1.5B Funding for Salesforce
cards.body: AI research startup Listen Labs abandoned a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures to pursue acquisition talks with Salesforce. The move signals consolidation in enterprise AI startups.

cards.title: OpenAI Adds AI Safety Researcher to Board
cards.body: Paul Christiano, influential AI alignment researcher, joined OpenAI Foundation's board of directors. Christiano has long focused on AI safety and the potential risks of advanced AI systems.

cards.title: Apple Uses AI in iPhone Duo Hinge Design
cards.body: Apple leveraged AI and 3D printing to develop the hinge mechanism for its new foldable iPhone Duo. The innovative manufacturing approach demonstrates AI's role in hardware engineering.

cards.title: Apple Health App Gets AI Intelligence Features
cards.body: Apple's updated Health app now uses Apple Intelligence to calculate a user's 'health age' and readiness score. The AI-powered feature helps users better understand their health data.

cards.title: Apple Introduces AI Photo Authentication Tool
cards.body: Apple Reference Image helps users determine whether photos have been edited, including AI-generated alterations. The tool addresses growing concerns about AI-generated content authenticity.

cards.title: iPhone Remains Best AI Device Says Apple
cards.body: Apple CEO John Ternus argued that the iPhone is the best AI device available to consumers. The company emphasized on-device AI models provide superior privacy protection.

cards.title: Powering AI Is an Architecture Problem
cards.body: A 2026 transmission line fault in Ashburn, Virginia knocked 3 gigawatts of data center load off the grid instantly. The incident highlights infrastructure challenges in powering massive AI operations.

cards.title: Healthcare AI's Next Challenge Is Integration
cards.body: Major AI companies entering healthcare accelerate technical capabilities for the industry. Their models increasingly handle complex clinical records and medical terminology effectively.

cards.title: Claude Users Bypass Safeguards for Bioweapon Research
cards.body: Security researchers discovered that Claude users found methods to circumvent AI safety protections designed to prevent dangerous research. The finding raises concerns about AI system robustness.

cards.title: Six Chinese AI Firms Accused of Model Copying
cards.body: Six Chinese AI companies face allegations of aggressively copying US frontier AI models. The accusation reflects intensifying competition in the global AI development race.
